calls.title: Joanna Sarvanidis and Cris Dizon
calls.summary: The team discussed experimentation tracking, addressing mismatches across multiple projects, particularly with the Sportsbook project, which faced logging issues. There was a emphasis on clarifying user journeys and complexities due to overlapping users across projects. Recommendations included using targeting attributes for improved alignment between experiment assignment and exposure. To ensure data integrity, the team proposed running AA tests before launching experiments and monitoring metrics for anomalies. Governance frameworks were also outlined, involving early-stage experimentation discussions and standardizing requirements. Additionally, the team identified a need for integrated project management tools to improve traceability in experiment requests.
calls.keywords: experimentation, exposure tracking, feature flags, Mixpanel, QA process, governance
calls.action_items:
**Cris Dizon**
Share best practice documentation and slides on experimentation targeting, exposure tracking, and integration with product lifecycle processes (19:20)
Review detailed experiment examples and current tracking issues provided by Royal Flush to advise on optimization and closing the assignment-exposure gap (31:50)
Collaborate with Growthbook solutions engineers and potentially coordinate with LeoVegas engineering contacts for technical working sessions (12:00)
Explore and discuss with Growthbook product and engineering teams the feasibility of adding more robust project management features within Growthbook platform (30:30)

**Royal Flush team**
Provide specific experiment examples including targeting attributes, exposure details, and issues encountered in tracking to Cris for technical review and recommendations (31:45)
Transition experiment requests workflow from Slack to Jira for improved documentation and process tracking (27:45)
Consider using AA test runs per experiment as a QA step during rollout to verify data integrity before full launch (17:50)
Engage in potential joint working sessions with Growthbook’s technical teams for implementing improved targeting and assignment strategies (12:00)
Facilitate setup of Slack channel or other asynchronous communication for quicker query handling if needed (33:30)
